item.title: Self-Hosted EV Charger Management: SteVe vs EVerest vs OpenOCPP
item.description: The electric vehicle revolution is creating a parallel need for charging infrastructure management. Commercial charging networks rely on cloud-based platforms, but for fleet operators, workplaces, and residential communities, self-hosted EV charger management provides full control over charging data, user privacy, and operational costs.
